home_article_4_title: Small routines that steady the mind
home_article_4_excerpt: Sleep, movement, and short pauses are not luxuries—they are the ground therapy builds on. Mentors often help you design tiny, realistic habits so progress continues between sessions instead of waiting for the next appointment.
home_article_5_title: Change feels slow until it suddenly clicks
home_article_5_excerpt: Insight rarely arrives as one dramatic breakthrough. More often it is repeated practice: noticing a pattern, choosing a different response, and reflecting afterward. Counseling makes that practice intentional so growth becomes measurable.
home_article_6_title: You do not have to wait for a crisis
home_article_6_excerpt: Many people start counseling while life is fine enough, because they want clearer goals, healthier relationships, or less rumination. Early support can prevent small struggles from hardening into long-term habits.
about_description: An online counseling platform built for clients and mentors?secure, multilingual, and easy to use.
about_hero_title: A safe space to be heard and grow
about_hero_subtitle: We provide confidential online counseling with trained mentors so you can work through anxiety, relationships, family topics, and personal growth with professional support.

privacy_subtitle: How we collect, protect, and respect the information you share on our counseling platform.
privacy_intro: This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information on our psychological counseling platform. By creating an account or using the service, you accept this policy.
privacy_highlight_title: We do not sell your data
privacy_highlight_body: Your sessions stay between you and your mentor. We only share what is necessary to run appointments and meet legal duties.
privacy_s1_body:
We may collect:
? Account details such as name, mobile number, and role (client, mentor, or admin)
? Appointment details such as date, time, mentor, and area of expertise
? Limited technical data needed for security and reliability
We do not store counseling conversation transcripts unless required to provide a feature and you knowingly submit that content.
privacy_s2_body:
We use your information to:
? Create and manage your account
? Book, display, and cancel appointments
? Send essential service notices about sessions or account status
? Improve security, quality, and usability
? Meet legal obligations when required
privacy_s3_body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share necessary details only with:
? The mentor connected to your appointment
? Technical providers bound by confidentiality who help us operate the platform
? Authorities when required by a valid legal obligation
privacy_s4_body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards. No system is perfectly risk-free. We keep data only as long as needed to provide the service or meet legal requirements.
privacy_s5_body:
Depending on applicable law, you may be able to:
? Access and update your account information
? Request correction of inaccurate data
? Request account deletion or processing limits where allowed
Contact support to make these requests.
privacy_s6_body: We may update this policy. The latest version will appear on this page with an updated date. Continued use after publication means you accept the revised policy.
terms_subtitle: The ground rules for a safe, respectful space between clients, mentors, and our platform.
terms_intro: By registering for or using the platform, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms_highlight_body: If you are in immediate danger or a mental-health crisis, contact local emergency services right away. This platform is for scheduled counseling.
legal_related_body: Explore more about how we work and how to reach us.
legal_related_privacy: How we handle your personal information.
legal_related_terms: Rules for using the counseling platform.
legal_related_faq: Quick answers about accounts, booking, and roles.
legal_related_about: Our mission and who this service is for.
terms_s1_body: This platform helps clients and mentors connect and manage online counseling appointments. Guidance shared in sessions comes from the relevant mentor and is not a substitute for emergency medical care, psychiatric crisis services, or hospital treatment.
terms_s2_body: You are responsible for keeping your login details secure. Provide accurate information and use the account only for lawful purposes. Impersonation, abuse, or disruption of the service is prohibited.
terms_s3_body: Appointments can be booked based on mentor availability. You may cancel through the app features. Mentors may also cancel or change sessions for professional or technical reasons; status updates appear in your appointments list.
terms_s4_body: Mutual respect is required. Harassment, threats, illegal content, or use outside counseling purposes may lead to suspension or termination of the account.
terms_s5_body: The service is provided "as is." To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect damages from temporary outages, personal decisions after sessions, or third-party actions. In an urgent crisis, contact local emergency services.
terms_s6_body: We may revise these terms. Updates will be published on this page. Continued use after changes means you accept the new terms.
faq_subtitle: Short answers about registration, booking, roles, and privacy.
faq_a1: Tap Get started or Register, choose client or mentor, then create an account with your mobile number and password.
faq_q2: What is the difference between client and mentor?
faq_a2: Clients choose an expertise area and book sessions. Mentors set specialties and weekly availability, then manage incoming appointments.
faq_q3: How do I book an appointment?
faq_a3: Open Book appointment, pick a topic, browse open slots, optionally filter by date or mentor, then confirm the booking.
faq_a4: Yes. In My appointments you can cancel an active booking. The status updates after cancellation.
faq_a5: We use safeguards to protect accounts and appointment data. More detail is available in the Privacy Policy.
faq_a6: No. The platform is for scheduled counseling. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency or crisis services.
faq_q7: How do mentors set expertise and availability?
faq_a7: Mentors select topics in Areas of expertise and mark open times in the weekly schedule so clients can book them.
faq_a8: The interface is multilingual. Change language from the header; layout direction follows the language (for example RTL for Persian and Arabic).
faq_more_body: Read the About page or register and start your counseling journey.
